description: This file implements the SetLog command for the server manager, allowing dynamic configuration of logging levels for different components via HTTP requests. It includes functions to convert string parameters into internal logging level enums and applies these settings through a service interface.

classes.name: SetLog
classes.description: A class that handles the 'SetLog' command, configuring logging levels based on HTTP request parameters.

methods.name: SetLog::SetLog
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SetLog object with a reference to the service and the HTTP request.

methods.name: SetLog::run
methods.description: Executes the command to set logging levels based on request parameters, sending an appropriate HTTP response.
